input: Batch label and freeze summer berry portions

gold.taskTitle: Batch Label and Freeze Summer Berry Portions
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to portion, label, and freeze a batch of summer berries for later use.

questions.title: Which specific berry types are you freezing?
questions.description: Identify the exact berries involved, e.g. strawberries, blueberries, raspberries, blackberries, or a mix.

questions.title: What is the total quantity of berries to process?
questions.description: Determine the volume or weight of berries that need to be portioned and frozen in this batch.

questions.title: What size should each individual portion be?
questions.description: Clarify the intended portion size per container, e.g. 1 cup, 200g, or a single-serving amount.

questions.title: What containers or bags will you use for freezing?
questions.description: Find out whether the user plans to use zip-lock bags, reusable silicone bags, rigid containers, or other packaging.

questions.title: What information needs to go on each label?
questions.description: Establish what the user wants written on labels, such as berry type, weight, date frozen, or intended use.

questions.title: Do the berries need any prep before portioning?
questions.description: Check whether washing, hulling, drying, flash-freezing on a tray first, or any other prep step is required.

questions.title: When do you need this entire batch completed by?
questions.description: Understand the deadline or time available for the task, including whether it must be done in one session.
